```yaml
name: Update ingestr

on:
  schedule:
    # Run daily at 09:00 UTC
    - cron: '0 9 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  check-and-update:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: 'go.mod'
          cache: true

      - name: Get current ingestr version
        id: get_current_version
        run: |
          CURRENT_VERSION=$(grep -o 'ingestrVersion = "[^"]*"' main.go | cut -d'"' -f2)
          echo "current_version=$CURRENT_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Check for new ingestr version
        id: check_version
        run: |
          LATEST_VERSION=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/bruin-data/ingestr/releases/latest | jq -r '.tag_name')
          echo "latest_version=$LATEST_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          if [[ "$LATEST_VERSION" != "$CURRENT_VERSION" ]]; then
            echo "new_version=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "new_version=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.check_version.outputs.new_version == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: update ingestr to ${{ steps.check_version.outputs.latest_version }}"
          title: "Update ingestr to ${{ steps.check_version.outputs.latest_version }}"
          body: |
            This PR updates the ingestr version from `${{ steps.get_current_version.outputs.current_version }}` to `${{ steps.check_version.outputs.latest_version }}`.
            
            Automated PR from update-ingestr workflow.
          branch: update-ingestr-${{ steps.check_version.outputs.latest_version }}
          delete-branch: true
```
